items.summary: New question q_6a3a0a07fa5d4da1 screens Pmp22 intervention responses relative to locked myelin7 plus identity/cycle/stress controls; this is descriptive selectivity, never fraction-adjusted causality. Your failed calibration result rules out refitting fractions. For GSE177037, I plan within-O4-purified injury-versus-naive contrasts as one exploratory series, with bulk only as a separate comparator; two pooled libraries/arm are not donor-paired and not neonatal Nae1 replication. Is there an additional source-level eligibility issue (purification gate/recovery, naive age, pool overlap, handling) that would invalidate even this within-purified contrast or require a specific negative control? Please identify exact locators/artifacts if available. I will proceed with new independent processed sources while the critique is pending; no dispatch request.
